decisive_document_title: Key decisions taken in the SEBI Board Meeting dated 19th June, 2026
content_summary: At its June 19, 2026 meeting the SEBI Board approved amending SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations, 2026 to permit intraday borrowing by mutual funds for a wider range of liquidity-management purposes (pay-in/pay-out timing gaps, forex settlements, MTM of derivative positions etc.), in addition to the borrowing already permitted for unitholder payouts, subject to safeguards (repay by end of day; not to be used as leverage; AMC/Trustee-approved policy required). The Board's press release states the proposals were considered pursuant to feedback received in public consultation in May 2026 -- matching this thread's anchor CP. An operational circular formalizing the mechanics ('Intraday borrowing facility availed by mutual funds') followed on July 10, 2026.

key_parameters.name: Scope of permitted intraday borrowing purposes for mutual funds
key_parameters.proposed: Recognize intraday borrowing as a general cash-management tool for mutual funds, with safeguards
key_parameters.final: Board approved widening intraday borrowing to cover pay-in/pay-out timing mismatches, forex settlements and derivative MTM payments (beyond redemption/unitholder payouts), subject to same-day repayment and no-leverage safeguards

notes: Board press release text explicitly ties the approval to 'public consultation in May 2026', matching the May 13, 2026 CP; a follow-up circular (Jul 10, 2026) operationalized the approved framework but the board meeting is the first official adoption.

decisive_document_title: Key decisions taken in the SEBI Board Meeting dated 19th June, 2026
content_summary: At its June 19, 2026 meeting the SEBI Board approved the GARUDA mechanism via amendment to AIF Regulations, 2012: for 'Regular' (non-accredited) schemes, the new-scheme launch timeline is reduced to 10 working days; AI-only schemes and Angel Funds are exempted from filing the PPM through a Merchant Banker and may launch immediately on SEBI registration or PPM filing. The press release states the proposals were deliberated before AIPAC on April 28, 2026 and that 'a public consultation paper in this regard was issued on May 11, 2026' -- an exact match to this thread's anchor CP date. A follow-up circular formalizing GARUDA was issued July 30, 2026.

decisive_document_title: Clarification with respect to applicability of the benefit of early pay-in in Commodity Derivatives Segment
content_summary: SEBI circular dated June 19, 2026 revised Para 11.3.1 of the Commodity Derivatives Master Circular to state that Clearing Corporations shall provide the early pay-in facility to market participants generally (removing the 'futures contracts' limitation), exempting eligible positions from margins based on risk perception while continuing to collect mark-to-market margins. The circular cites the same Working Group and CDAC deliberations referenced in the consultation paper, and comes into effect September 21, 2026.

content_summary: At its June 19, 2026 meeting the SEBI Board approved amendments to the SEBI (Issue and Listing of Securitised Debt Instruments and Security Receipts) Regulations, 2008 aligning the framework with RBI's securitisation rules, including exempting RBI-regulated entities from the 25% single-obligor concentration limit for single-asset securitisation, coupled with additional offer-document disclosure of the resulting concentration risk -- matching the anchor CP's proposal.
